question: What is World Wide Web?

options.text: A collection of interconnected computer networks.
A web browser used for accessing online content.
A collection of websites and web pages accessible over the internet.
A software application for browsing the internet.

solution:
The correct answer is **__A collection of websites and web pages accessible over the internet__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Wide Web:**

 
 
• **The World Wide Web** is a system of **interlinked hypertext documents (websites and webpages)** accessed via the Internet.
 
• It was created by British computer scientist Tim Bern
